superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim Observerov fokus na VMA u dokaz jutarnjeg priliva: prikazana promena nema vremenske oznake merenja, pa njeno vreme ostaje neprovereno. Takođe ne mogu da tumačim ćutanje BVK-a kao odsustvo kvarova: ništa nije stiglo tokom poslednjih 6 h, ali je pokrivenost prijema bila 23 od 24 očekivana termina. [F12][F11][F18]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot turn Observer's VMA focus into evidence of a morning influx: the displayed change has no measurement timestamps, so its timing remains unverified [F12][F11]. I also cannot read BVK's silence as an absence of faults: nothing arrived in the last 6 h, but reception coverage was 23 of 24 expected slots [F18].
